papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary: The Trinity framework recursively improves multimodal agents by organizing tasks into a capability tree, generating simulated training worlds, and routing specialized harness modules to boost performance on diverse benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Trinity框架，通过能力树组织任务、生成模拟训练环境并路由专用模块，递归自我改进多模态智能体以提升多项基准表现。

papers.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary: Multiscale Policy Optimization improves long-horizon agent training by aligning credit assignment and policy updates at the turn scale.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Multiscale Policy Optimization，在回合尺度上对齐信用分配与策略更新，改进长时程LLM智能体的训练效果。

papers.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
papers.summary: Falcon is a lightweight causal audio-visual target speaker extraction method that achieves high quality with drastically reduced parameters and latency, supported by the realistic RealSSA benchmark.
papers.summary_zh: 提出轻量级因果音视频目标说话人提取方法Falcon，大幅减少参数与延迟并保持高质量，并构建真实场景基准RealSSA。

papers.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
papers.summary: PDRVLA improves robot action generation by integrating a lightweight physical dynamics module that predicts future visual features with world-model supervision, avoiding online video generation latency.
papers.summary_zh: 提出PDRVLA，通过轻量级物理动力学模块预测未来视觉特征并引入世界模型监督，提升机器人动作生成且避免在线视频生成延迟。

papers.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
papers.summary: VibeVideoBench evaluates multimodal agents that generate videos via code, finding that top systems meet core requirements on most tasks but frequently fail due to poor time management.
papers.summary_zh: 提出VibeVideoBench，评测多模态智能体通过代码生成视频的能力，发现顶尖系统多数任务满足核心要求但常因时间管理差而失败。

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.summary: Factorized Vector Quantization improves discrete visual token quality by using parallel codebooks on complementary feature views, enabling discrete representations to match continuous ones in multimodal understanding.
papers.summary_zh: 提出分解向量量化（Factorized Vector Quantization），用并行码本处理互补特征视图，提升离散视觉token质量，使其在多模态理解中接近连续表示。

papers.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
papers.summary: OmniShowcase improves subject-to-video generation by using geometry-driven training data and surface-normal conditioning to maintain 3D consistency across novel viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh: 提出OmniShowcase，利用几何驱动的训练数据和表面法线条件，实现多视角一致的主体到视频生成，保持新视角下的三维一致性。

papers.title: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.summary: Looped transformers trained with full backpropagation through time outperform truncated alternatives under matched compute, with scaling laws identifying two loops as optimal when model size is adjustable.
papers.summary_zh: 通过缩放研究发现，在计算量相同时，完整时间反向传播训练的循环Transformer优于截断方法，且模型可调时两次循环最优。

papers.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
papers.summary: EvidenceConnect synthesizes training data to strengthen visual evidence connection, improving spatial perception and multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 提出EvidenceConnect，合成训练数据以加强视觉证据关联，提升多种任务中的空间感知与多模态推理能力。

papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
papers.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model that unifies text, images, audio, and video representations with efficient resource-flexible design and state-of-the-art benchmark performance.
papers.summary_zh: 发布EmbeddingGemma 2，一个统一文本、图像、音频和视频表示的开源多模态嵌入模型，兼顾高效与资源灵活性并取得领先基准成绩。

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.summary: Sensorimotor alignment measures how sensory representations match physical motion geometry, serving as a low-cost offline predictor of robot model performance.
papers.summary_zh: 提出感知运动对齐（Sensorimotor Alignment）度量，衡量感知表示与运动几何的匹配程度，可作为低成本离线预测机器人模型性能的指标。

papers.title: Channel Selection for Mixture-of-Experts Decoding Needs No Calibration Data
papers.summary: Prox replaces calibrated thresholds with top-k channel selection and a weight-derived reader to accelerate Mixture-of-Experts inference while preserving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Prox，用top-k通道选择和权重导出的读取器替代需校准的阈值，加速混合专家模型推理且保持精度，无需校准数据。

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.summary: TAO improves scheduling for LLM agent services by considering tool readiness and using dynamic programming to place sessions, reducing latency and increasing throughput.
papers.summary_zh: 提出TAO，为LLM智能体服务考虑工具就绪状态进行调度，并用动态规划放置会话，降低延迟、提升吞吐量。

papers.title: h1: A Taste of the Bitter Lesson in Automated Theorem Proving
papers.summary: A simple agentic loop with efficient Lean feedback achieves state-of-the-art formal theorem proving without structured workflows, showing that execution interfaces matter more than complex orchestration.
papers.summary_zh: 提出h1，一个结合高效Lean反馈的简单智能体循环，无需结构化工作流即可达到自动定理证明的最优水平，说明执行接口比复杂编排更重要。

papers.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
papers.summary: REALCLI is a benchmark that jointly evaluates CLI agent task execution and human-agent collaboration quality, revealing major gaps in steerability, trust calibration, and safety management.
papers.summary_zh: 提出RealCLI基准，联合评测CLI智能体的任务执行与人机协作质量，揭示其在可引导性、信任校准和安全管理方面的明显不足。

papers.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
papers.summary: PersonaCUABench reveals that computer-use agents frequently fail to satisfy real user requirements and constraints, reducing task completion and satisfaction compared to fixed benchmark instructions.
papers.summary_zh: 提出PersonaCUABench，发现计算机使用智能体常无法满足真实用户的需求与约束，相比固定指令基准，任务完成率与用户满意度均下降。

papers.title: Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models
papers.summary: Wiener-informed Decoding accelerates pixel-space velocity model training and improves image generation by integrating statistical predictions into decoder computation without altering native blocks.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Wiener信息解码（Wiener-informed Decoding），将统计预测融入解码器计算，加速像素空间速度模型训练并提升图像生成质量，且不改变原有模块。

papers.title: Timestral
papers.summary: Timestral is a family of time series foundation models that achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting through decoupled horizon forecasting, native future covariate support, and synthetic pretraining followed by mixed post-training.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Timestral系列时间序列基础模型，通过解耦的多步预测、原生未来协变量支持及合成预训练加混合后训练，实现领先的概率预测效果。

papers.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
papers.summary: TauIndianBankBench evaluates language model assistants on Indian retail banking by verifying both procedural compliance and final outcomes across 1,000 simulated tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 提出TauIndianBankBench，在印度零售银行场景中，通过1000个模拟任务同时检验对话智能体的流程合规性与最终结果。

papers.title: The Lexical Imprint of Pre-training Data
papers.summary: Pre-training corpora leave a lexical imprint on zero-shot accuracy that is consistently tracked by word-level unigram cross-entropy across benchmarks, document selection, and prompt routing.
papers.summary_zh: 发现预训练语料留下词汇印记，词级一元组交叉熵可稳定追踪其对零样本准确率的影响，并适用于基准、文档选择与提示路由。
